long_biography.plain_text:
Before entering shipping management, Lauro founded and held senior executive positions in private companies focused chiefly on real estate, golf courses and resort development. That work established a business-building background outside maritime transport and gave him experience across property and hospitality ventures before he joined the Monaco-based Scorpio group in 2010.

Within Scorpio, Lauro moved into senior management and became vice president of Scorpio Tankers in 2015. He has also held vice-presidential roles in related listed shipping businesses, including Eneti, while remaining part of the group's leadership structure. His present role centres his public career in product-tanker shipping, following an earlier period as a founder and executive in property-led enterprises.
